name: Prisoner activity allocation history
description: Activities a prisoner has been allocated to over the past 12 months, combining NOMIS and DPS Activities allocations, including at previous prisons

dataset.name: Prisoner activity allocations, last 12 months
dataset.query: WITH allocations AS ( SELECT al.prisoner_number, a.summary AS activity, a.prison_code AS allocation_prison_code, al.start_date AS start_date, COALESCE(al.end_date, CAST(al.deallocated_time AS date)) AS end_date, CASE WHEN al.deallocated_reason IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE UPPER(SUBSTRING(REPLACE(al.deallocated_reason, '_', ' '), 1, 1)) || LOWER(SUBSTRING(REPLACE(al.deallocated_reason, '_', ' '), 2)) END AS end_reason, CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS end_comment, 'DPS Activities' AS source FROM datamart.prisons.activities_allocation al INNER JOIN datamart.prisons.activities_activity_schedule s ON s.activity_schedule_id = al.activity_schedule_id INNER JOIN datamart.prisons.activities_activity a ON a.activity_id = s.activity_id WHERE al.start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND COALESCE(al.end_date, CAST(al.deallocated_time AS date), CURRENT_DATE) >= DATEADD(month, -12, CURRENT_DATE) UNION ALL SELECT o.offender_id_display, ca.description, p.agy_loc_id, CAST(p.offender_start_date AS date), CAST(p.offender_end_date AS date), CASE WHEN p.offender_program_status = 'END' THEN rc.description END, CASE WHEN p.offender_program_status = 'END' THEN p.offender_end_comment_text END, 'NOMIS' FROM datamart.prisons.nomis_offender_program_profiles p INNER JOIN datamart.prisons.nomis_offender_bookings b ON b.offender_book_id = p.offender_book_id INNER JOIN datamart.prisons.nomis_offenders o ON o.offender_id = b.offender_id LEFT JOIN datamart.prisons.nomis_course_activities ca ON ca.crs_acty_id = p.crs_acty_id LEFT JOIN datamart.prisons.nomis_reference_codes rc ON rc.domain = 'PS_END_RSN' AND rc.code = p.offender_end_reason WHERE p.offender_program_status IN ('ALLOC', 'END') AND p.create_user_id <> 'PRISONER_MANAGER_API' AND p.offender_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND COALESCE(p.offender_end_date, CURRENT_DATE) >= DATEADD(month, -12, CURRENT_DATE) ) SELECT pr.prison_id AS prison_code, al.prisoner_number, pr.name AS prisoner_name, al.activity, est.name AS prison_name, al.start_date, CASE WHEN al.end_date IS NULL THEN 'Ongoing' ELSE TO_CHAR(al.end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') END AS end_date, al.end_reason, al.end_comment, al.source FROM allocations al INNER JOIN datamart.person.prisoner pr ON pr.prisoner_number = al.prisoner_number LEFT JOIN datamart.establishment_establishment est ON est.id = al.allocation_prison_code ORDER BY al.start_date DESC

report.name: Prisoner activity allocation history
report.description: Activities a prisoner has been allocated to over the past 12 months, including at previous prisons. Only prisoners at your current caseload prison are shown.
